title: Five more ways to build with Pollinations
summary:
A community-heavy day: new browser-only BYOP examples, creative apps, healthier model discovery, and analytics that can finally count what happened.

The app directory gained PersonaMorph for wallet-connected artistic photo edits and Oracle Mystique for illustrated three-card tarot readings. Both are small, opinionated examples of what happens when image generation, chat, OAuth, and somebody's very specific idea collide.

Three Arabic RTL apps joined the directory: baboolharech, Text to Speech in video_audio, and aaarraaa. Each demonstrates the BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE flow entirely in the browser, so builders can explore authenticated image, speech, and login flows without first adopting the ancient tradition of maintaining a backend.

The /v1/models and /models endpoints now return cached health data by default, including 24-hour status, success rate, and request volume. Developers can make a more informed model choice before finding out the interesting way; the API safely reports unknown when the health feed is unavailable.

highlights.title: Model discovery now includes vitals
highlights.text: `/v1/models` and `/models` return each model’s recent health, success rate, and request volume—so choosing a model involves slightly less divination. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: PersonaMorph turns photos into personas
highlights.text: Connect a Pollinations wallet and use image edits to remake portraits as artistic identities. [Try it](https://personamorph-ai-production.up.railway.app)

highlights.title: Oracle Mystique deals three illustrated cards
highlights.text: Ask the AI tarot reader for a Past, Present, and Future spread, with generated card art and BYOP OAuth2. [Try it](https://oracle-mystique.up.railway.app)

highlights.title: Arabic browser-only text-to-speech
highlights.text: An RTL app lets Arabic-speaking makers sign in with BYOP PKCE and generate speech without maintaining a backend. [Try it](https://thinglover21-ux.github.io/My-app-mod)
